name: INTEL_DISCOVERY_PROSE_TICKERS_LQ110_20261107
comment: to its whole ticker pattern, so any capitalised word after 'stock'/'shares of'/'bought'/'sold'
became a symbol. Read-only over 1,310 live articles on 2026-11-07 that yielded 67 candidates,
59 of them English (PRICE 49, SEES 12, HAS 9, JUMPS 7 ...); each became a watchlist row and then
a strategy card — 170 of the 350 cards classified intel_discovery have no price bar at all, and
206 of the 221 NULL-price cards never had one. Three behaviours are pinned here: the SYMBOL is
case-sensitive while the context word is not; a candidate with no price bar inside the lookback
is dropped AND counted, with the symbol named on the run result (a gate that only shortens a
list is indistinguishable from a scan that found nothing); and one failing insert rolls back to
its own savepoint instead of discarding every earlier insert of the run while still being
counted as added. Hermetic: synthetic symbols only, fake cursor, no DB, no network.
